summary: Applied all six blind-review findings against the uncommitted BL-620 os-unit ownership/log-rotation work in libs/host-runtime; all host-runtime + sox suites GREEN. Committed 4 files as f60dc93a.

changes.kind: BL-627 compact YYYYMMDD rotation date; BL-629 copytruncate (copyFileSync + truncateSync) instead of rename; BL-630 distinct os-out/os-err filePrefixes + legacy-aware finder; converted require('./data-paths.js') to top-level import for source-testability
NEW — rotation copytruncate/truncation assertions + BL-630 prefix/finder tests
BL-631 unchanged short-circuit now calls verifyUnitOnDisk before reporting verified:true
BL-628 broken platform subclass fix; BL-631 body-tampered-already-loaded rewrite test; BL-620 INV-2 blocked-while-loaded gate-input test; added OsUnitPlatform type import

BL-627.detail: rotateOsUnitLogs now computes the archive date via todayDateString().replace(/-/g, '') so the renamed archive is <name>.<YYYYMMDD> (8-digit), matching the prune regex \.\d{8}$ and the docstring/spec. log-manager.spec.ts asserts /^doctor-tick-os\.out\.log\.\d{8}$/.

BL-628.detail: The INV-2 verify test's 'broken' platform was an object spread { ...new LaunchdPlatform(), render(){} } which dropped all prototype methods (unitFileName/load/isLoaded), so enableOsUnit threw TypeError at setup. Replaced with class BrokenPlatform extends LaunchdPlatform { override render() {...} }, so the test genuinely asserts a tampered unit is NOT loaded.

BL-629.detail: rotateOsUnitLogFile now uses copytruncate semantics: fs.copyFileSync(activePath, rotated) then fs.truncateSync(activePath, 0) — the active inode/fd is preserved so the supervisor keeps writing to the (truncated) active file, bounding disk without a restart. Prune regexes unchanged. Spec asserts active path size 0 + archive holds the rotated bytes instead of rename-absence.

BL-630.detail: findAllLogStreamsForExt now emits filePrefix ${extId}-os.out / ${extId}-os.err (distinct), and findMostRecentLogFile gained logStreamFileMatches which matches the stable form by prefix and the legacy <extId>-os-<date>.<out|err>.log form by a derived dated-shape regex. soxe logs/follow can now distinguish stdout from stderr.

BL-631.detail: enableOsUnit's unchanged short-circuit now calls verifyUnitOnDisk(unitPath) and returns unchanged only when selfConsistent && bodyHash === newHash; a body-tampered-but-header-intact already-loaded unit falls through to the rewrite path (verified:true after rewrite).

EXIT-CODE-CONFIRMATION.detail: The blocked (env-drop-guard) path returns verified:false and loaded:currentlyLoaded, and the enable gates in cmdService enable + doctor --install-tick are `!dryRun && (!result.loaded || !result.verified)`. A blocked-while-loaded enable therefore exits non-zero — this IS the intended semantic (a blocked regeneration must never read as success), and it correctly covers doctor --install-tick which has no explicit blocked short-circuit (unlike cmdService enable/update). Added an os-unit.spec.ts test asserting a blocked-while-loaded enable reports loaded:true + verified:false and that the gate condition (!loaded || !verified) is true. No gate adjustment needed.
